dialogue:
Alice: Budget hotels have poor cleanliness in my experience.
Bob: Many budget hotels now maintain high cleanliness standards.
Alice: That changes my view; budget hotels sound acceptable now.

Tom: The phone battery felt weak yesterday.
Support: The battery learns usage patterns after calibration.
Tom: After calibration, the battery feels good.

Student: The NLP system seems hard to use.
Teacher: The interface now provides one-click extraction.
Student: The system is convenient after that update.

Buyer: This laptop looks attractive.
Reviewer: The fan noise becomes terrible during training.
Buyer: The laptop is risky for my workload.

Guest: The restaurant price seems high.
Friend: The set meal includes drinks and dessert.
Guest: The price is reasonable with that package.

User: The app is useful.
Friend: It crashes on the login page.
User: That makes the app unreliable.

Researcher: The model comparison seems unnecessary.
Advisor: It directly matches the scoring rubric.
Researcher: The model comparison is valuable for the report.

Customer: The room looks clean.
Clerk: The room faces a noisy street.
Customer: The room is less attractive now.

Tester: The one-shot prompt is enough.
Developer: The JSON validity drops on long dialogues.
Tester: The four-step prompt is safer.

Analyst: The public dataset is difficult.
Teacher: Public evaluation gives the strongest bonus evidence.
Analyst: The public dataset is worth using.

Alice: The charger is acceptable.
Bob: It overheats after thirty minutes.
Alice: The charger sounds unsafe.

Student: Gradio looks unnecessary.
Classmate: It helps answer defense questions with live examples.
Student: Gradio is useful for the defense.

Manager: The report is already strong.
Reviewer: It lacks references from recent papers.
Manager: The report needs stronger literature support.

User: The keyboard is poor for typing.
Friend: The new version uses a softer switch.
User: The keyboard could be comfortable now.

Buyer: The price is attractive.
Seller: The warranty lasts only one month.
Buyer: The price advantage is weaker now.

Guest: The location seems inconvenient.
Host: The subway entrance is beside the building.
Guest: The location is convenient after all.

Engineer: The API is stable.
Tester: It returns invalid JSON under long prompts.
Engineer: The API needs more robust validation.

Teacher: The student project is simple.
Student: It includes public evaluation and model comparison.
Teacher: The project has solid depth.

Reviewer: The camera is excellent in daylight.
User: Night photos are blurry.
Reviewer: The camera has a low-light weakness.

Alice: The dessert looks ordinary.
Bob: It won a local food award.
Alice: The dessert sounds impressive.

Student: The dataset size is enough.
Advisor: The rubric rewards more than one hundred test samples.
Student: The dataset should be expanded.

Customer: The soup is too spicy.
Waiter: We can make a mild version.
Customer: The soup is suitable with that option.

User: The search feature is reliable.
Friend: It misses recent documents.
User: The search feature is limited.

Analyst: The fallback data is weak.
Developer: It keeps the evaluation script runnable offline.
Analyst: The fallback data is useful for validation.

Guest: The hotel looks quiet.
Host: Construction starts at seven every morning.
Guest: The hotel may be noisy.

Student: The defense questions are scary.
Teacher: Most questions target design choices already in your report.
Student: The defense questions are manageable.

Developer: The rule baseline is enough.
Evaluator: It cannot explain complex opinions.
Developer: The LLM pipeline is necessary.

Buyer: The headphones are good.
Reviewer: The microphone is poor.
Buyer: The headphones are less suitable for meetings.

Student: The references are hard to collect.
Librarian: The report can cite official docs, datasets, and ASTE papers.
Student: The references are manageable.

User: The extraction result is confusing.
Developer: The table now separates speaker, target, aspect, opinion, sentiment, and rationale.
User: The extraction result is clear now.
